newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up three cents to 14.17/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up three cents to 14.17/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price edged up three cents to 14.17 ringgit ($5.65) a kg on active buying after the rise of the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday.
"There was very strong support in early trading due to Friday's LME, but some selling emerged at the lower level and the price consolidated," said a trader.

Initial bids were 161 tonnes against offers of 97. Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia. Turnover was hardly changed at 147 tonnes, from 148 on Friday. The premium over the LME narrowed to $65 a tonne from $90 previously.
